release: Market Core V2.0-Alpha · Build 38.15.4 · Classic Graph Comparison Recovery
notes: Built from the runtime-stable Build 38.15.2, not from rejected Build 38.15.3.
Build 38.15.2 Atlas → NØX → Aerith end-of-cycle stability fix preserved.
Global chart cache preserved so Top 3 / Top 5 / Gainers / Losers / Volume histories are not emptied.
Old serialized workspace graph is not replayed.
Analyst workspace restore is CoinGecko-only; Binance historical fallback is excluded there.
Solo and comparison historical datasets no longer receive a synthetic Binance LIVE terminal point.
Top 3 / Top 5 may combine CoinGecko direct, Bridge-CoinGecko and qualified CoinGecko cache series; acquisition mode need not be identical.
Bridge fallback uses allowBinance=false and accepts only CoinGecko provider for Analyst comparison.
Scanner acquisition code and Market data pipeline are unchanged.
AUTO/MANUAL Atlas mode remains deferred until Classic graph behavior is validated.
